user.title: DG-LAB connection
user.description: Choose how the DG-LAB app connects.

details.title: DG-LAB connection settings
details.description: In direct mode, enter a Home Assistant address reachable from the DG-LAB app.

data_description.emulated_opossum: Adds a virtual two-channel Opossum for testing dashboards and automations without physical hardware.
data_description.connection_attempts_per_minute: Failed pairing attempts allowed from each source IP during any rolling minute.
data_description.messages_per_second: Inbound WebSocket messages allowed from each app during any rolling second. The connection is closed when exceeded.
data_description.max_app_connections: Maximum number of external DG-LAB apps that may remain connected simultaneously.
